description: Report or reload the server's config file. action="status" (the default) shows the config path, when it was loaded, the sha256 of its bytes and the result of the last reload; never the contents. action="reload" re-reads the file, validates it exactly as startup does, and applies it only if every check passes; a refused reload changes nothing. Command-line flags are never reloaded. Applying closes connections, with their sessions, whose profile was removed or whose connection fields changed, and clears approval grants.

action.description: "status" (default) reports the loaded config; "reload" re-reads and applies the file

name: reload-config
